data.narrative:
QunaSys is a Series B quantum computing company that has raised $33M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 tracked peers: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. The stage-progression approach uses the $33M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the next funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $63M. This method is grounded in observed capital efficiency patterns across venture-stage quantum computing but assumes QunaSys will execute at median cohort pace.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable: while 8 private quantum companies exist in the broader comp set, no meaningful subset met narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparability. Using the full-sector median would introduce uncontrolled heterogeneity. The triangulated range spans $53M (low) to $72M (high), centered on the $63M median. Key uncertainties include the appropriate capital-to-value progression multiple for this specific stage transition, execution risk relative to stage cohort norms, and the absence of direct peer benchmarks for validation. This analysis should be updated once additional quantum computing companies report Series B+ valuations.
